timings.text: Namaste! Is video mein hum Claude AI ka poora interface step by step samjhenge.
timings.en: Hello! In this video, we'll understand the complete Claude AI interface, step by step.

timings.text: Har option kya hai, kaise use karte hain, aur uski limitations kya hain.
timings.en: What each option is, how to use it, and what its limits are.

timings.text: Aur end mein Claude Code ka real demo bhi dekhenge.
timings.en: And at the end, we'll watch a real Claude Code demo.

timings.text: Ye Claude ka home screen hai. Main yahan Pro plan use kar raha hoon.
timings.en: This is Claude's home screen. I'm using the Pro plan here.

timings.text: Screen ke teen main hisse hain:
timings.en: The screen has three main parts:

timings.text: left side mein sidebar,
timings.en: the sidebar on the left,

timings.text: beech mein message box,
timings.en: the message box in the middle,

timings.text: aur neeche aapka account.
timings.en: and your account at the bottom.

timings.text: Kuch options aapke plan aur account ke hisaab se alag dikh sakte hain.
timings.en: Some options may look different depending on your plan and account.

timings.text: Sabse upar New button hai. Isse nayi chat shuru hoti hai.
timings.en: At the top is the New button. It starts a new chat.

timings.text: Har chat ki apni conversation hoti hai, isliye naye topic ke liye nayi chat shuru kijiye.
timings.en: Each chat is its own conversation, so start a new chat for a new topic.

timings.text: Search se aap apni purani chats dhoondh sakte hain.
timings.en: With Search, you can find your old chats.

timings.text: Pro plan mein aap Claude se bhi pooch sakte hain ki pichhli baar humne kya discuss kiya tha.
timings.en: On Pro, you can also ask Claude what you discussed last time.

timings.text: Projects ek workspace hai, jismein aap files aur instructions save kar sakte hain.
timings.en: Projects is a workspace where you save files and instructions.

timings.text: Project ki har chat in files ko context ki tarah use karti hai.
timings.en: Every chat in the project uses these files as context.

timings.text: Banane ke liye Projects kholiye, New Project dabaiye, naam likhiye, aur files add kijiye.
timings.en: To create one: open Projects, click New Project, add a name, then add files.

timings.text: Dhyaan rakhiye, project ki chats aapas mein baat share nahi karti, sirf project knowledge share hoti hai.
timings.en: Note: project chats don't share their conversations, only the project knowledge.

timings.text: Artifacts woh cheezein hain jo Claude aapke liye banata hai, jaise document, code, website ya diagram.
timings.en: Artifacts are things Claude makes for you: documents, code, websites or diagrams.

timings.text: Ye chat ke side panel mein khulte hain, aur sab Artifacts page par save rehte hain.
timings.en: They open in a side panel, and all of them are saved on the Artifacts page.

timings.text: Aap inhe edit, export aur share kar sakte hain. Shuru mein ye private hote hain.
timings.en: You can edit, export and share them. They start out private.

timings.text: Code option Claude Code ke liye hai, jo coding ka agentic tool hai.
timings.en: The Code option opens Claude Code, an agentic coding tool.

timings.text: Web par aap GitHub repository connect karke task dete hain.
timings.en: On the web, you connect a GitHub repository and give it a task.

timings.text: Claude cloud mein kaam karta hai, aur aap changes review karke pull request bana sakte hain.
timings.en: Claude works in the cloud; you review the changes and create a pull request.

timings.text: Ye Pro plan mein included hai, lekin aapki usage limit mein count hota hai.
timings.en: It's included in Pro, but it counts toward your usage limits.

timings.text: Customize mein Skills, Connectors aur Plugins milte hain.
timings.en: Customize is where you find Skills, Connectors and Plugins.

timings.text: Skills Claude ko naye kaam sikhati hain, Connectors bahar ki services se jodte hain,
timings.en: Skills teach Claude new tasks, Connectors link outside services,

timings.text: aur Plugins skills aur commands ka bundle hote hain.
timings.en: and Plugins bundle skills and commands together.

timings.text: Usage mein aap dekh sakte hain ki aapne kitna use kiya hai.
timings.en: Under Usage, you can see how much you've used.

timings.text: Pro plan mein session limit har paanch ghante mein reset hoti hai, aur ek weekly limit bhi hoti hai.
timings.en: On Pro, the session limit resets every 5 hours, and there's a weekly limit too.

timings.text: Chats and tasks mein aapki purani chats aur tasks hain. View all se poori list khulti hai.
timings.en: Chats and tasks holds your past chats and tasks. View all opens the full list.

timings.text: Kisi chat par hover karke teen dots se aap use rename ya delete kar sakte hain.
timings.en: Hover over a chat and use the three-dot menu to rename or delete it.

timings.text: Neeche apne naam par click karke Settings khulti hai.
timings.en: Click your name at the bottom to open Settings.

timings.text: Yahan appearance, memory aur chat search jaisi settings milti hain.
timings.en: There you'll find settings like appearance, memory and chat search.

timings.text: Upar right corner mein ye ghost icon incognito chat ke liye hai.
timings.en: The ghost icon in the top-right corner starts an incognito chat.

timings.text: Incognito chat history aur memory mein save nahi hoti, aur band karne ke baad dobara nahi khulti.
timings.en: Incognito chats aren't saved to history or memory, and can't be reopened once closed.

timings.text: Ab message box dekhte hain. Yahan aap apna sawaal ya kaam likhte hain.
timings.en: Now the message box. This is where you type your question or task.

timings.text: Jitna clear prompt likhenge, utna accha jawab milega.
timings.en: The clearer your prompt, the better the answer.

timings.text: Plus button se Add files or photos chun kar files attach kijiye.
timings.en: Click the plus button, choose Add files or photos, and attach your files.

timings.text: PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, text aur images support hoti hain, ek chat mein bees files tak.
timings.en: PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, text and images are supported, up to 20 files per chat.

timings.text: Isi menu se aap ek chat ke liye memory bhi band kar sakte hain, pehla message bhejne se pehle.
timings.en: The same menu can turn memory off for a chat, before you send the first message.

timings.text: Ye Chat aur Cowork ka option hai. Chat jaldi sawaal jawaab ke liye hai.
timings.en: This is the Chat / Cowork switch. Chat is for quick questions and answers.

timings.text: Cowork mein aap poora task dete hain, aur Claude kai steps mein khud kaam karta hai,
timings.en: In Cowork, you hand over a whole task and Claude works through the steps itself,

timings.text: jaise research karna, files padhna, aur spreadsheet ya presentation banana.
timings.en: like researching, reading files, and making spreadsheets or presentations.

timings.text: Cowork zyada usage leta hai, aur actions se pehle permissions ka dhyaan rakhiye.
timings.en: Cowork uses more of your usage, so check permissions before it takes actions.

timings.text: Ab model selector. Yahan abhi Opus 5.5 aur Medium effort selected hai.
timings.en: Next, the model selector. Opus 5.5 with Medium effort is selected right now.

timings.text: Model name par click karke aap model badal sakte hain, More models mein aur options milte hain.
timings.en: Click the model name to switch models; More models shows extra options.

timings.text: Effort batata hai ki Claude kitna soch kar jawab dega: Low, Medium, High, Extra high aur Max.
timings.en: Effort sets how deeply Claude thinks: Low, Medium, High, Extra high and Max.

timings.text: Zyada effort se jawab behtar hota hai, par time aur usage zyada lagta hai.
timings.en: Higher effort gives better answers, but takes more time and usage.

timings.text: Rozana ke kaam ke liye Medium kaafi hai, mushkil coding ya planning ke liye effort badhaiye.
timings.en: Medium is fine for everyday tasks; raise it for hard coding or planning.

timings.text: Mic aur voice buttons se aap type karne ki jagah bol bhi sakte hain.
timings.en: With the mic and voice buttons, you can speak instead of typing.

timings.text: Aur neeche Write, Learn, Code jaise buttons se shuruaat ke liye ideas milte hain.
timings.en: And buttons like Write, Learn and Code below give you ideas to get started.

timings.text: Ab Claude Code ka real demo dekhte hain, terminal mein.
timings.en: Now let's watch a real Claude Code demo, in the terminal.

timings.text: Install karne ke liye official command chalaiye, phir claude version se check kijiye.
timings.en: To install, run the official command, then check it with claude --version.

timings.text: Ye ek chhota sa demo project hai, ek todo app.
timings.en: This is a small demo project: a to-do app.

timings.text: Main Claude Code se project ki files explain karne ko kehta hoon.
timings.en: I ask Claude Code to explain the project's files.

timings.text: Claude ne files padh kar har file ka kaam samjhaya, aur ek bug bhi pakad liya!
timings.en: Claude read the files, explained each one, and even spotted a bug!

timings.text: Ab app chalate hain. Ye KeyError de raha hai.
timings.en: Now let's run the app. It crashes with a KeyError.

timings.text: Main Claude Code ko error batata hoon aur fix karne ko kehta hoon.
timings.en: I tell Claude Code about the error and ask it to fix it.

timings.text: Is command mein maine sirf file edit karne ki permission di hai.
timings.en: In this command, I've allowed file edits only.

timings.text: Claude ne bug fix kiya, aur bataya ki app chalane ke liye approval chahiye tha, jo maine nahi diya tha.
timings.en: Claude fixed the bug, and said running the app needed approval, which I hadn't given.

timings.text: Yahi Claude Code ki safety hai: file badalne ya command chalane se pehle permission.
timings.en: That's Claude Code's safety: permission before changing files or running commands.

timings.text: Ab git diff se exact change review karte hain: name ki jagah title.
timings.en: Now we review the exact change with git diff: 'name' became 'title'.

timings.text: Aur ab app sahi chal raha hai.
timings.en: And now the app runs correctly.

timings.text: Claude Code mein permission modes hote hain: Manual, Accept edits, Plan aur Auto.
timings.en: Claude Code has permission modes: Manual, Accept edits, Plan and Auto.

timings.text: Shuruaat mein Manual ya Plan mode sabse safe rehta hai.
timings.en: When you're starting out, Manual or Plan mode is the safest choice.

timings.text: Ab kuch zaroori baatein.
timings.en: Now, a few important points.

timings.text: AI galti kar sakta hai, isliye jawab aur code hamesha verify kijiye.
timings.en: AI can make mistakes, so always verify answers and code.

timings.text: Passwords, API keys ya private data chat mein share mat kijiye.
timings.en: Don't share passwords, API keys or private data in chats.

timings.text: Changes ko run karne se pehle review kijiye.
timings.en: Review changes before you run them.

timings.text: Aur yaad rakhiye, Pro plan mein bhi usage limits hoti hain.
timings.en: And remember: even the Pro plan has usage limits.

timings.text: Agli videos mein hum Projects, Artifacts, Cowork aur Claude Code ko detail mein seekhenge.
timings.en: In the next videos, we'll learn Projects, Artifacts, Cowork and Claude Code in detail.

timings.text: Video accha laga ho to like kijiye, aur channel subscribe kar lijiye. Dhanyavaad!
timings.en: If you liked this video, hit like and subscribe. Thank you!
